fair_value_reason: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 of ~$35.3 (0.75 x FY28 ~$34, the midpoint of the $32.96 MarketBeat and $34.73 StockAnalysis consensus, plus 0.25 x FY29 ~$39) at ~30x, a ~10% discount to the ~33x consistent-NTM peer median for concentration and cyclicality, gives ~$1,059. Adding $10.7/sh net cash ($2,738M cash and investments less $1,637M debt, on 103M shares) gives ~$1,070. That is up $20 from my round-1 $1,050 because a second aggregator puts FY28 ~$1-2 higher. It is ~$22 above the $1,048 round-2 agent mean: correcting agent_1's premium multiple brings it down, while agent_5's spot-anchored leg and agent_3's normalised leg remain judgment.

thesis_triggers.event: Four of the five agents are at $600 and agent_3 is at $660. At $600 the stock would trade at ~17x NTM EPS of ~$35 at the horizon, below the lowest US peer NTM P/E (AVGO ~19x) and NVIDIA's $695.31 preferred entry, and well under the July-2026 no-news low (~$720). Only an earnings break (a guide-down, a cut at Customer A or B, a hyperscaler capex pause, or an EML pricing reset) gets there; $750-850 is ordinary noise at ~75-97% volatility. agent_3's $660 is reasonable but sits within one ordinary 1-sigma down-move, so I keep $600.

supervisor_summary: Round 2 adopted the round-1 corrections (FY28 EPS ~$33-35, $1.1B net cash, 103M shares), and four agents independently re-confirmed the EPS base on a second aggregator. The mean ladder, however, now sits within 0.003 of my round-1 ladder, which is anchoring, not five independent views. My comps re-computation shows the peer NTM P/E median is ~32-34x, not ~37x. LITE trades at 43x NTM with peer-median growth, so ~30x on Oct-2027 NTM EPS of ~$35 gives a ~$1,070 fair value, ~1.5% below spot. Agent_1's $1,130 rests on a premium it labelled a discount. I keep the mean ladder (P(>= $1,085) ~0.49) and a $600 thesis break; there is no edge either way.
key_drivers: Q1 FY27 guide: $1.225-1.275B revenue, 39.5-40.5% op margin, $4.05-4.35 EPS. Consensus FY27 $19.8-21.8 and FY28 $33.0-34.7 (MarketBeat; StockAnalysis, 24 analysts); the CEO talks of ~$40 of 2028 earnings power (a verbal remark, not guidance).

Valuation hinges on the horizon multiple. Peer NTM P/E median is ~32-34x on a consistent basis; LITE is at 43x NTM and 31x FY28 today with peer-median EPS growth, so ~30x on Oct-2027 NTM EPS of ~$35 plus $10.7 net cash gives ~$1,070.

Supply side: Changguang Huaxin plans 200G EML output in Q4 2026 and Source Photonics already ships, but the InP substrate gap is >70% and is seen lasting to 2028 (Omdia/Yole via C114). The margin reset is more likely after the horizon than within it.
Concentration and cyclicality: Customer A 26.6% and Customer B 15.0% of FY26 revenue. FY24 revenue fell 23% and the company had an operating loss. Trailing ROIC is 16% vs a peer median of ~21-24%.
Capital structure: ~$1.10B net cash, ~103M diluted shares, convert principal cash-settled. Steady 10b5-1 insider selling (CFO 24,542 shares at $1,048.50 on Oct 1).
